This enhancement aims to create a more seamless and user-friendly experience, ensuring that users aren't abruptly caught off guard by media starting unexpectedly when they are in the middle of something else, thereby promoting a more controlled playback environment for users. **This change matters because it enhances user focus and respects their audio context, preventing unwanted distractions.**

With Markdown becoming increasingly popular, this update aligns Firefox's documentation practices with current standards in the developer community, helping ensure that contributors can focus more on content rather than formatting challenges. _While users may not see immediate changes, this shift is significant for the overall development process._

This change is significant because it allows developers to leverage HLS for delivering high-quality live broadcasts and on-demand video directly in the browser, improving the overall streaming experience for users. By properly integrating HLS, Firefox enhances compatibility with various video services, paving the way for better media playback without needing additional plugins or players.
